# 2qrcode.com

> Free client-side suite of 72 permanent static QR code generators, a Batch CSV QR Studio, a 300 DPI Metric Print Converter, and 97 E-E-A-T verified technical guides built by Afzal Naveed.

All QR codes are generated 100% locally in the browser (ISO/IEC 18004 standard) with zero middleman redirects, zero scan limits, and zero expiration traps.

## Core Tools & Studios
- [QR Code Generators Directory (72 Tools)](https://2qrcode.com/): Browse all 72 specialized static QR code builders.
- [Full-Featured QR Customizer Studio](https://2qrcode.com/?view=customizer): Customize dots, eyes, linear gradients, centered logos, and CTA frames.
- [Batch CSV QR Code Generator](https://2qrcode.com/?view=batch): Bulk generate branded QR codes from CSV spreadsheets into a single ZIP archive.
- [Metric Print Size & 300 DPI Converter](https://2qrcode.com/?view=converter): Calculate physical print dimensions using the 10:1 scanning distance ratio.
